decisions.briefing: Markets were risk-on today with the NASDAQ up 1.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.6%. With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we filled all three slots with SKYD, INFQ, and SEI, the top-scoring candidates showing full multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, bullish RSI, price above SMA-20, and volume surge), consistent with the lesson to deploy dry powder on genuine risk-on days.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today was led by the NASDAQ (+1.1%) outpacing the S&P 500 (+0.6%), suggesting growth and tech-adjacent names continued to attract buying interest. Several smaller-cap names in our screener, including SKYD and INFQ, showed volume surges alongside bullish MACD crossovers, a pattern often associated with institutional accumulation rather than retail noise. The breadth of bullish technical signals across the candidate list reinforces that today's move was a genuine risk-on session rather than an isolated single-stock rally.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走強，納斯達克指數上漲1.1%，領先標普500指數的0.6%升幅，顯示科技及成長股持續吸引買盤。篩選名單中多隻中小型股，包括SKYD和INFQ，同時出現成交量放大及MACD黃金交叉的現象，這種組合訊號通常被視為機構資金進場而非散戶炒作。整體技術訊號廣泛轉強，印證今日屬於真正的風險偏好（risk-on）行情，而非單一股票的個別反彈。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) crossover happens when a stock's MACD line moves above its signal line, which can signal the start of upward momentum. Traders often combine it with other signals like RSI and volume to confirm the move is real rather than a brief blip, which is exactly why today's buys required all four signals together.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD（指數平滑異同移動平均線）黃金交叉是指股票的MACD線向上穿越訊號線，往往被視為上升動力開始的訊號。交易者通常會配合RSI及成交量等其他指標一併確認，以避免誤判短暫的價格波動，這正是今天買入決策要求四項訊號同時出現的原因。
